_comment: COMPOSE_KG_PROMPT — ONLY-ORACLE variant. condition=only_oracle => the block shows ALL gold pieces and NOTHING else: every non-emerging oracle entity + every oracle relation (emerging ends are omitted on purpose — the model must MINT those). k is IGNORED for only_oracle (no distractors, no truncation). This is the retrieval-perfect ceiling. Change `component_dir` to the _aida output to run it on that index.
